statement: Refusing the payment is safe and correct for this case because Tomas Vega cancelled his Fitline membership on 3 July with confirmation from the club.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "active, renewing" status contradicts the stated cancellation — "Tomas Vega cancelled his Fitline membership on 3 July with confirmation from the club" — so the charge must be refused.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
